note: Pretzels, peanuts and cashews roasted in smoked paprika butter, with beef jerky

dish.n: Cab driver's pretzel, peanut and jerky mix
dish.make_ahead: Keeps 1 week in an airtight tin

steps.text: Toss the pretzels and nuts with melted butter, paprika and sugar.
Roast at 160C.
Cool.
Tip into paper bags with strips of jerky.

note: Double fried wings glazed in gochujang honey sauce

steps.text: Toss the wings in the starch.
Fry at 160C, then rest.
Fry again at 190C until shattering.
Simmer the gochujang, soy, honey and garlic until glossy.
Toss the wings in the sauce and top with sesame.

note: Lager battered fish strips in corn tortillas with cabbage and chipotle crema

steps.text: Whisk the flour and cold lager into a batter.
Mix the sour cream with chipotle and lime juice to make crema.
Shred the cabbage and cut the fish into strips.
Dip the fish in batter and fry at 180C for 3 minutes.
Serve in warm tortillas with cabbage, crema and lime wedges.

note: Browned chipolatas glazed in honey and wholegrain mustard, on toothpicks

steps.text: Grill the chipolatas until browned.
Toss in a hot pan with honey and mustard until sticky.
Spear on toothpicks and serve hot. Do you like dags?

film: Lock, Stock and Two Smoking Barrels (1998)
note: Smoked mackerel blended with cream cheese and horseradish, on toasted rye with cucumber

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Flake the mackerel, removing the skin and bones.
Blitz with the cream cheese, horseradish, lemon juice and black pepper until mostly smooth.
Toast the rye.
Spread on the toast and top with thin cucumber slices.

film: Lock, Stock and Two Smoking Barrels (1998)
note: Puffed roasted pork crackling with a splash of malt vinegar

dish.make_ahead: Keeps 3 days in paper bags

steps.text: Score the pork rind into strips and rub well with salt.
Dry uncovered in the fridge overnight.
Roast on a rack at 220C until puffed and crackling.
Brush lightly with malt vinegar while hot, then toss in sea salt flakes.
Tip into paper bags.

note: Poached prawns on shredded iceberg with tomato horseradish sauce in martini glasses

dish.make_ahead: Sauce up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Poach the prawns in salted water for 2 minutes, plunge into iced water and peel.
Mix the tomato sauce, horseradish, lemon juice and Worcestershire sauce.
Chill the prawns.
Serve over shredded iceberg in martini glasses with lemon wedges.

note: Crisp fried balls of shredded beef in a thick creamy filling

dish.make_ahead: Fill the day before, chill overnight

steps.text: Braise the beef with the onion and thyme until it falls apart, then shred.
Cook the butter with the flour, add the stock and the beef.
Chill overnight.
Roll into balls and crumb in egg and panko.
Fry at 180C.
Serve with grainy mustard.

note: Bresaola, burrata, figs, olives and breadsticks with olive oil and lemon

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 hours ahead

steps.text: Lay the bresaola on a board with the burrata, halved figs, breadsticks and olives.
Drizzle with good olive oil and a squeeze of lemon.

note: Hot garlic and anchovy olive oil dip with fennel, peppers, radishes and bread

steps.text: Slice the fennel, capsicum and radishes and the bread.
Melt the butter in the oil over very low heat with crushed garlic and the anchovies until the anchovies dissolve.
Keep warm over a candle and dip the vegetables and bread.

note: Crab salad with celery, chives and lemon in baby cos lettuce leaves

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 hours ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Finely dice the celery and chop the chives.
Mix the crab with mayonnaise, celery, chives, lemon zest and juice and paprika.
Spoon into baby cos leaves and serve cold.

note: Buckwheat pancakes with crème fraîche, salmon roe and chives, frozen vodka alongside

dish.make_ahead: Batter rests up to 2 hours

steps.text: Mix the flour, yeast and warm milk and rest until bubbly.
Cook small spoonfuls in butter until golden.
Top each with creme fraiche, salmon roe and snipped chives.
Serve beside frozen vodka.

note: Baked yeast buns filled with beef, onion and dill

dish.make_ahead: Bake the day you serve

steps.text: Mix the flour, yeast, warm milk and some butter into a soft dough.
Prove.
Fry the mince with the onion and dill and cool.
Fill rounds of dough and seal.
Bake at 200C.
Brush with melted butter.

note: Prosciutto wrapped figs, warm orange olives and cheddar shards on toothpicks

dish.n: Fig prosciutto, olive and cheddar picks
dish.make_ahead: Up to 4 hours, keep chilled

steps.text: Wrap each fig half in a piece of prosciutto.
Warm the olives in a small pan with the orange peel and fennel seeds until fragrant.
Break the cheddar into shards and push everything onto toothpicks so nobody gets greasy fingers on the cards.

note: Steamed pork and prawn dumplings with ginger and shiitake

dish.make_ahead: Uncooked dumplings up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Mix the pork, prawns, ginger, mushrooms and soy.
Spoon into the wonton wrappers, wet the edges and pinch up the sides.
Steam in batches for 8 minutes. Top each with a dot of roe.

note: Crisp oatcakes topped with crème fraîche, smoked salmon and dill

dish.make_ahead: Oatcakes up to 2 days ahead, airtight

steps.text: Mix the oats with the melted butter, salt and a splash of hot water into a stiff dough.
Press thin and cut into rounds.
Bake at 180C for 20 minutes and cool.
Top with crème fraîche, smoked salmon, dill and a squeeze of lemon.

note: Pork crackling and sausage wrapped soft eggs, crumbed and fried, with pickled onions

dish.n: Black Prince crackling and scotch eggs
dish.make_ahead: Crackling and eggs up to 4 hours ahead

steps.text: Score the pork rind, salt it well and roast at 240C until blistered and crisp. Break into pieces.
Boil the eggs for 6 minutes, cool in iced water and peel.
Wrap each egg in sausage mince, dust in flour, dip in beaten egg and crumb in panko.
Fry at 170C for 7 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Serve with the crackling, pickled onions and English mustard.

note: Cucumber mint cream cheese and smoked salmon dill butter sandwiches, crusts off

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 hours, cover with a damp paper towel

steps.text: Mix the cream cheese with the mint and spread on half the bread.
Top with thin cucumber and a second slice of bread.
Mash the dill into the butter, spread on the remaining bread and layer with salmon.
Trim the crusts and cut into perfectly straight fingers.

note: Baguette slices topped with potato salad, ham and sliced egg

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 hours, cover with a damp cloth

steps.text: Boil the eggs for 10 minutes, cool and slice.
Slice the baguette into rounds and spread with butter.
Top each with potato salad, a fold of ham, a slice of egg, a gherkin slice and parsley.
Line them up neatly on a long board.

note: Fresh fried prawn crackers served with sweet chili and lime sauce

steps.text: Heat the oil to 190C.
Fry a few crackers at a time for a few seconds until they puff up dramatically. Drain on paper towel.
Mix the sweet chilli sauce with the lime juice and serve for dipping.

note: Crisp baked wings tossed in hot sauce butter and honey, blue cheese dip

dish.make_ahead: Wings can dry overnight uncovered in the fridge

steps.text: Pat the wings dry and season. Bake at 220C for 45 minutes, turning once.
Melt the hot sauce with the butter and honey and toss the wings through it.
Mash the blue cheese into the sour cream. Serve the wings with the dip and celery.

note: Lager battered fish strips in tortillas with cabbage, tomato and lime sour cream

dish.make_ahead: Slaw and salsa up to 2 hours ahead

steps.text: Whisk the flour with the lager into a batter. Mix the sour cream with lime juice.
Dice the tomato and onion and shred the cabbage.
Dip the fish in batter and fry at 180C for 3 minutes, in batches, until golden.
Warm the tortillas and fill with fish, cabbage, tomato, onion and the lime cream.

note: Crisp fries topped with melted cheddar and crisp bacon

dish.n: Hard Deck bacon cheese loaded fries

steps.text: Bake the chips at 220C until crisp.
Fry the bacon until crisp.
Top the chips with cheddar and bacon and grill for 2 minutes to melt.
Finish with sour cream, jalapeño and chives.

note: Toasted marshmallows with salted caramel between sweet cookies

steps.text: Spread half the biscuits with a little caramel and a pinch of sea salt.
Toast the marshmallows over a fire or under the grill until golden.
Sandwich each marshmallow with a square of milk chocolate between two biscuits and squash together.

note: Chicken thigh strips with smoked paprika and cumin, grilled until blackened

dish.make_ahead: Chicken can marinate up to 1 day

steps.text: Cut the chicken into strips and rub with the paprika, cumin and chilli. Thread onto skewers.
Grill hot until blackened at the edges.
Mix the yoghurt with the garlic and salt for a dip.

note: Wholemeal bread with lemon butter, smoked salmon, dill and capers, cut in squares

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 hours, cover and keep chilled

steps.text: Mash the butter with the lemon zest.
Spread on the bread and top with smoked salmon, dill and capers.
Cut into neat squares.

note: Fresh shucked oysters on ice with lemon and shallot mignonette

dish.make_ahead: Mignonette up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Mix the shallots with the vinegar and cracked pepper.
Rest the mignonette for 20 minutes.
Lay the oysters on crushed ice with lemon wedges and serve with the mignonette.

note: Crusty ham and English mustard sandwiches with buttered small potatoes

dish.n: King of the world ham sandwiches

steps.text: Boil the potatoes in their skins until tender.
Butter thick slices of loaf and fill with ham and mustard.
Toss the drained potatoes with butter and salt. Serve together below deck.

note: Medjool dates stuffed with goat's cheese and almond, wrapped in prosciutto, honey

steps.text: Split the dates and stuff each with goat's cheese and an almond.
Wrap each in a piece of prosciutto.
Bake at 200C for 8 minutes and drizzle with honey.

film: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom (1984)
note: Chipolatas coiled into a snake, glazed with mango chutney and chili, yogurt dip

dish.n: Coiled chipolata snake with mango glaze

steps.text: Coil the chipolatas tightly on a tray, pinning with skewers.
Brush with mango chutney mixed with the chilli. Bake at 200C for 20 minutes.
Stir the cumin into the yoghurt and serve alongside. Surprise.

film: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom (1984)
note: Mango puree and whipped cream set in dome molds, turned out chilled

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Blitz the mangoes with the sugar into a purée.
Soak the gelatine leaves in cold water, then dissolve in a little warm purée and stir through the rest.
Fold in the whipped cream and spoon into dome moulds.
Set in the fridge for 4 hours.
Turn out and top with passionfruit pulp.

film: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)
note: Baguette toasts with smoked cod, prosciutto and fig, or sardines and raisins

dish.n: Venice cod, prosciutto and sardine toasts
dish.make_ahead: Toppings up to 4 hours ahead

steps.text: Boil the potato until soft. Poach the cod in milk for 8 minutes, then flake.
Beat the flaked cod with the potato and olive oil into a rough spread.
Toast the baguette slices.
Top a third with the cod spread and parsley, a third with prosciutto and fig, and the rest with sardines, onion and raisins.

note: Pan fried crab cakes with Dijon mayo, served with lemon

dish.make_ahead: Shape up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Fold the crab with the mayo, egg, mustard and breadcrumbs.
Shape into cakes and chill for 30 minutes.
Pan-fry in butter until golden and serve with lemon.

note: Garlic fennel roast pork, broccolini and provolone on small buns

dish.make_ahead: Pork up to 1 day ahead, reheat in its juices

steps.text: Rub the pork with garlic, rosemary and fennel seeds.
Roast at 160C for 3 hours. Rest and slice thin.
Fry the broccolini with garlic and chilli.
Pile the pork, greens and provolone into the buns and spoon over the pan juices.

note: Hot smoked trout, sharp cheddar, apple, pickled onions and crackers

dish.n: Smoked trout and cheddar snack plate

steps.text: Flake the trout onto a wooden board.
Add the crackers, cheddar, apple and pickled onions the way a mountain lodge would set it out.

note: Crab with mayo, lemon, chives and cayenne on buttered toast fingers

steps.text: Fold the crab with the mayo, lemon juice, chives and cayenne.
Toast the bread, butter it and cut into fingers.
Pile the crab on top.

note: Fried clam fritters with chopped clams in a light batter

steps.text: Drain the clams, keeping the juice.
Mix the flour, baking powder, egg and some of the clam juice, then fold in the clams.
Spoon into oil at 180C and fry until puffed and golden.
Serve with lemon and tartare sauce.

note: Franks dipped in buttermilk cornmeal batter and fried golden

steps.text: Whisk the cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder, egg and buttermilk into a thick batter.
Pat the franks dry and push onto sticks.
Dip in batter and fry at 180C for 4 minutes until golden, in batches.
Serve with mustard.

note: Pinto beans with bacon, chipotle, molasses and tomato paste, cooked in cast iron

dish.make_ahead: Better the next day

steps.text: Fry the bacon and onion in a cast-iron pot until golden.
Add the beans, chipotle, molasses, tomato paste and water.
Simmer for 30 minutes until thick and smoky.
Serve in tin cups.

note: Chocolate cookies sandwiched with marshmallow

steps.text: Melt the chocolate with the butter, beat in the sugar and egg, then the flour.
Shape small rounds and bake at 175C for 9 minutes. Cool.
Sandwich pairs of cookies with a marshmallow each and warm for 1 minute to melt.
Roll the edges in silver sprinkles.

note: Pickled herring with dill new potatoes, sour cream, chives and red onion

dish.n: Pelle's pickled herring and new potatoes

steps.text: Boil the potatoes with the dill until tender.
Serve warm with the herring.
Add a bowl of sour cream with chives and thinly sliced red onion.

note: Long soft rolls dressed with oregano vinaigrette and layered Italian style

dish.make_ahead: Up to 3 hours ahead, wrapped tight

steps.text: Whisk the oil, vinegar, oregano, salt and pepper.
Split the rolls and drizzle the insides with half the dressing.
Layer with provolone, salami and ham.
Top with lettuce, tomato, red onion and pickled peppers, drizzle with the rest of the dressing and close.
Wrap each tightly in baking paper and halve.

note: Deviled eggs, ham and pineapple picks, chive cream cheese on cucumber

dish.make_ahead: Up to 3 hours, keep chilled

steps.text: Boil the eggs for 10 minutes, cool, peel and halve.
Whip the yolks with mayo and paprika and pipe back into the whites.
Thread the ham and pineapple onto toothpicks.
Pipe the cream cheese mixed with chives onto the cucumber rounds.
Serve on silver trays.

note: Crab with mayo, lemon and chives piled on garlic rubbed sourdough toasts

steps.text: Fold the crab with mayo, lemon juice, chives and cayenne.
Toast the sourdough and rub with the cut garlic.
Pile the crab on top and serve straight away.

note: Chicken salad with avocado and cos in soft rolls, wrapped for the boat

dish.make_ahead: Up to 3 hours, wrap tight

steps.text: Mix the chicken with the mayo and lemon juice.
Pile into the rolls with sliced avocado and crisp cos.
Wrap tight in paper for the boat.

note: Buttermilk soaked calamari in a cornmeal crust, with tartare and lemon

steps.text: Soak the calamari in buttermilk for 15 minutes.
Mix the cornmeal and flour and dredge the calamari.
Fry at 185C for 90 seconds, in batches.
Serve with tartare and lemon wedges.

note: Buttermilk soaked fried chicken bites with a honey mustard dip

dish.make_ahead: Chicken can soak up to 8 hours

steps.text: Soak the chicken in buttermilk for an hour.
Season the flour with paprika, garlic powder and salt and toss the chicken through it.
Fry at 180C for 4 minutes, in batches.
Mix the honey and Dijon and serve with the chicken.

note: Grilled sourdough sandwiches with sharp cheddar, salami and sliced pickles

steps.text: Butter one side of every slice of sourdough.
On the unbuttered side of half the slices layer cheese, salami and pickles, then more cheese. Top with the remaining bread, buttered side out.
Cook in a pan over medium-low heat for 3 to 4 minutes a side, pressing down, until golden and melted.
Cut into fingers and serve with hot English mustard.

note: Popcorn tossed with crumbled bacon, maple and brown butter

dish.n: Stovetop maple bacon brown butter popcorn

steps.text: Fry the bacon until very crisp, then crumble.
Heat the oil in a heavy pot over medium heat, add the kernels, cover and shake constantly until the popping slows. Pull it off straight away.
Cook the butter in a small pan until golden brown and nutty, then stir in the maple syrup.
Pour over the popcorn and toss with the bacon and a good pinch of salt.

note: Deviled eggs, grape jelly glazed cocktail franks, celery filled with cream cheese

steps.text: Boil the eggs for 10 minutes, cool, peel and halve. Whip the yolks with mayo and paprika and pipe back in.
Simmer the franks in the barbecue sauce and grape jelly until sticky.
Fill the celery boats with cream cheese and sliced olives.

note: Pan fried pork and cabbage dumplings with ginger, steamed until tender

dish.make_ahead: Fill up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Mix the pork, wombok and ginger.
Fill the gyoza wrappers and pleat.
Fry until browned, add water and steam under a lid for 4 minutes.
Mix the soy and Chinkiang vinegar for dipping.

note: Marshmallows on skewers with chocolate faces, toasted if you like

steps.text: Stack two marshmallows on each skewer.
Pipe eyes and a smile on each with the melted chocolate.
Toast half of them with a blowtorch for the full effect.

note: Puff pastry spirals with tomato relish, ham and cheddar

dish.make_ahead: Rolls can be chilled up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C. Lay the pastry flat and spread with tomato relish.
Cover with ham and cheddar and roll up tightly from one edge.
Chill the logs for 15 minutes.
Cut each log into slices, lay flat on lined trays and brush with beaten egg.
Bake for 15 minutes until puffed and golden.

note: Grape juice jellies set in small round molds

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Soak the gelatine leaves in cold water.
Warm the grape juice with the sugar and a squeeze of lemon and stir in the squeezed gelatine.
Pour into small round moulds and set in the fridge for 3 hours.
Turn out and top each with a dot of whipped cream.

note: Pork and red chile tamales in masa dough

dish.make_ahead: Filled tamales up to 1 day ahead, steam to reheat

steps.text: Simmer the pork until tender, then shred and mix with the red chilli sauce.
Soak the corn husks in warm water.
Beat the masa with the lard, baking powder and stock to a soft dough.
Spread on the husks, add the pork and fold.
Steam for 60 minutes.
Serve with salsa.

note: Prawns coated in panko and shredded coconut, fried, with sweet chili lime dip

steps.text: Set up a station: flour, beaten egg, then the panko mixed with the coconut.
Dip each prawn in flour, egg, then the crumb mix.
Fry at 180C for 2 minutes, in batches.
Serve with sweet chilli sauce mixed with lime juice.

note: Diced tuna in soy and sesame over sushi rice with cucumber

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 hour ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Cook the sushi rice and cool.
Toss the tuna with soy, sesame oil, spring onion and chilli.
Spoon the rice into small cups and top with tuna and cucumber.
Warm the milk with the cardamom and cinnamon until steaming.
Turn off the heat and steep for 10 minutes. Strain.
Return to the heat and whisk in the chocolate, sugar and salt until smooth and frothy.
Pour into mugs and top with whipped cream, marshmallows and grated chocolate.

note: Diced tuna in soy and sesame on rice crackers

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 hour ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Toss the tuna with soy, sesame oil, spring onion and chilli.
Spoon onto rice crackers and serve straight away.

note: Steamed pork dumplings with garlic chives and ginger, soy and black vinegar

dish.make_ahead: Fill up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Mix the pork, garlic chives and ginger.
Fill the dumpling wrappers and pleat.
Steam for 8 minutes.
Serve with soy and Chinkiang vinegar, and pour the tea carefully.

note: Salmon and avocado rolls in nori, served with soy

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 hours, keep chilled

steps.text: Cook the rice and season with vinegar and sugar. Cool.
Spread over the nori, fill with salmon and avocado and roll tight with a mat.
Slice with a wet knife.
Serve with soy and pickled ginger. Smile and wave, boys.

note: Vanilla cupcakes covered in marshmallow and rolled in coconut

steps.text: Beat the butter and sugar, add the eggs and vanilla and fold in the flour.
Bake in a muffin tin at 180C for 18 minutes. Cool.
Melt the marshmallows with the water.
Spread over the tops and roll in coconut so they look like snowballs.

note: Shifu trains Po by making him fight for the last dumpling

dish.make_ahead: Fold up to 1 day ahead on a floured tray, or freeze

steps.text: Mix the pork with the wombok, ginger and spring onions and season.
Fold spoonfuls into the wrappers, sealing the edges with water.
Steam in batches over simmering water until cooked through.
Mix the soy, black vinegar and chilli oil for dipping.

note: Franks dipped in buttermilk cornmeal batter and fried golden

dish.make_ahead: Batter can be made 1 hour ahead

steps.text: Whisk the cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder, egg and buttermilk into a thick batter in a tall glass.
Pat the franks dry and push each onto a stick.
Heat the oil to 180C in a deep pot.
Dip each frank in batter and fry a few at a time until golden.
Drain and serve with mustard and tomato sauce.

note: Hollowed cob loaf filled with pesto, ham and roasted peppers, pressed and sliced

dish.make_ahead: Make the day before, keeps 2 days chilled

steps.text: Cut the top off the loaf and pull out most of the soft inside.
Spread the pesto inside the loaf.
Layer in the ham, capsicum, mozzarella, spinach, salami and tomatoes, pressing each layer down.
Put the lid back on, wrap tightly in plastic wrap and press under a heavy pot in the fridge overnight.
Cut into wedges to serve.

note: Marshmallow puffed rice treats cut into neat cubes

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, airtight

steps.text: Line a square tray with baking paper.
Melt the butter and marshmallows together over low heat.
Stir through the puffed rice until well coated.
Press firmly into the tray and leave to set.
Cut into neat cubes and stack into towers.

film: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets (2002)
note: Sausages, bacon, tomatoes and fried eggs with buttered toast

dish.make_ahead: Best served hot

steps.text: Fry the sausages until browned.
Push the sausages aside, add the bacon and tomatoes and cook.
Crack in the eggs and fry until the whites set.
Toast and butter the bread.
Load up the plates and pass them down the table.

film: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets (2002)
note: Fresh green apple juice jelly set in small glasses

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, keep chilled

steps.text: Juice the apples with a squeeze of lemon.
Warm the juice with the sugar.
Soak the gelatine leaves in cold water, squeeze, and stir into the warm juice until dissolved.
Pour into small glasses and chill until set.
Sprinkle with popping candy just before serving.

film: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire (2005)
note: Sticky pan fried sausages and golden onions in soft rolls with brown sauce

dish.make_ahead: Best served hot

steps.text: Fry the sausages slowly in a heavy pan until sticky.
Fry the onions in the butter until golden.
Fill the rolls with sausage and onions and add a good squirt of brown sauce.

film: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire (2005)
note: Crisp chorizo glazed with honey and chili, on toothpicks with cheddar

dish.make_ahead: Best served warm

steps.text: Fry the chorizo in a hot pan until crisp.
Add the honey and chilli flakes and cook until sticky.
Spear onto toothpicks with cubes of cheddar.

film: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring (2001)
note: Bacon, fried mushrooms, grilled tomatoes and marmalade toast, served mid-morning

dish.make_ahead: Best served hot

steps.text: Grill the bacon and tomatoes.
Fry the mushrooms in the butter.
Toast the bread and spread with butter and marmalade.
Serve on a big platter.

film: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King (2003)
note: Thyme butter drumsticks with cherry tomatoes, red grapes and crusty bread

dish.make_ahead: Best served warm

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C. Rub the drumsticks with butter, thyme and salt.
Roast until cooked through.
Lay on a long board with the tomatoes, grapes and torn bread.

note: Beef and horseradish cream on toast, salmon and crème fraîche on blinis

dish.make_ahead: Best made fresh, assemble just before serving

steps.text: Sear the eye fillet in a hot oiled pan to rare, then rest and slice thin.
Toast the baguette slices.
Top the toast with beef and horseradish cream.
Top the blinis with creme fraiche, smoked salmon and chives.
Serve on black trays.
